sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Distance and angle measurement: measure_distance calls measure::distance_mm (canonical millimetres, 1e9 coordinate bound) and measure_angle calls measure::angle_degrees (undirected [0,180] degrees, zero-length direction refused). Both return typed DTOs and stage no mutation; object-to-object measurement, length/radius/area/volume and labels remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Point-to-point distance and line-to-line angle only.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Object bounds: object-local box/size/center from point position, 33-sampled curve points or mesh vertices; unsupported kinds refused; read-only.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Sampled curve bounds; three geometry kinds only.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Curve length: sampled 33-point chord length in object-local mm; non-curve unsupported.
Circle radius: native circle/arc record radius in object-local mm; other curve kinds refused.
Object count/type summary by geometry kind, staged-consistent.
Measurement label: one bounded Progress line through the plugin message pipeline.
Mesh area: fan-triangulated planar face area sum in object-local mm².
